items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: J. A. Rogers came every Saturday, I took classes with him.

ctx.x: Off the mic you mentioned J. A. Rogers would come in.

J. A. Rogers came every Saturday, I took classes with him. I was happy during that time. Dakota Staton’s husband Taleb played in Dizzy’s band for a while. When I worked in high school I worked for him in his office there, he had a place on 52nd and Gerard. He used to write to J. A. Rogers, he did tech, enterprising, he was her husband and he brought J. A. Rogers every Saturday from New York and we would have a small class. So those things-Philly was very open. Kwame Nkrumah, he had an international parade on the…
To me it seems like Philly and Chicago were really the centers.
